Why does the AI era require multiple technological routes?
— From GPUs to dedicated ASICs, and then to integrated memory and computing in the next five years
Over the past decade, AI computing can almost be summed up in a simple logic: stronger GPUs, larger clusters, and higher computing power. NVIDIA/AMD has built a very powerful AI computing platform with GPU, CUDA/ROCm, HBM, high-speed connectivity, and a complete software ecosystem. 
But today, AI development has begun to change this logic.
With the rapid development of large models, agents, robots, and multimodal AI, the problems faced by AI computing are no longer just "insufficient computing power," but have gradually become excessive

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can build and own the technical accounting function in a fast-growing AI hardware environment.
We’re looking for someone with:
• 10+ years of accounting experience
• CPA required
• Deep expertise in ASC 606, revenue recognition, GAAP and SEC reporting
• Big 4 experience strongly preferred
• Experience with hardware, manufacturing, inventory, warranties or complex customer contracts
• A track record of building processes and leading teams
